name: br.com.doutorchamada/doutor-chamada
title: Doutor Chamada
description: Telemedicine in Brazil: on-call GP by video daily 7am-10pm (BRT); specialists by appointment.

tools.name: verificar_plantao
tools.description: Checks only Doutor Chamada's general-practitioner on-call service, with no appointment: whether it is open now (service hours in Brasília time) and, if closed, when it reopens. Does not report availability for specialists, whose video consultations are by appointment. Takes no input; never send symptoms or personal data.

tools.name: listar_opcoes_de_consulta
tools.description: Lists general-practitioner video consultation options (on call, no appointment) and scheduled specialist video consultations, who each is for, prices and website links. Specialist names, prices and links come from the website catalog. Use for service options and prices, never to assess symptoms or recommend a specialty based on symptoms. Takes no input; never send symptoms or personal data.

tools.name: iniciar_consulta
tools.description: Returns the website link and steps for the chosen video consultation, with the emergency notice. General-practitioner consultations are on call, without an appointment: sign up, pay on the website and wait for video. Specialists are by appointment: choose a time, sign up and pay on the website, then join the video consultation at that time. On-call closure does not restrict specialist scheduling. This tool does not book or pay for a consultation. Inputs are the option and an optional catalog specialty; never ask for or send symptoms or personal data. Do not assess symptoms or promise documents; documents depend on the doctor. For emergencies call 192; CVV 188 supports people with suicidal thoughts.

opcao.description: clinico_geral = adult (18+) general practitioner; crianca = patient under 18, the parent or guardian signs up; aptidao_fisica = sports and fitness evaluation; taf = physical fitness evaluation for a public-service exam; estrangeiro = foreigner in Brazil without CPF. These five options use the general-practitioner on-call service without an appointment; if age group is unknown for these options, ask whether the patient is an adult or a child. especialista = scheduled specialist video consultation; use the specialty explicitly chosen by the person, or omit especialidade to return the catalog.

especialidade.description: Optional catalog specialty, only with opcao=especialista. Use the specialty explicitly chosen by the person; never infer it from symptoms. Omit to return the /especialidades hub.

tools.name: tirar_duvida
tools.description: Returns Doutor Chamada's official answers (the same as the FAQ on the website) for one topic: how it works, medical certificates, prescriptions, exams, documents, payment and refunds, children and family, safety and data protection, and when not to use telemedicine. Use to answer questions about the service accurately. The only input is the topic.

tema.description: como-funciona = how it works, waiting time, video, hours, app; atestado = medical certificates (sick notes); receitas = prescriptions and renewals; exames = exam requests; documentos = receiving and fixing documents; pagamento = price, payment methods, refunds; familia = children and family; seguranca = trust, data protection, document validation; emergencias = when NOT to use telemedicine.
